newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Tortured body of Moroccan unionist found in sea.
newsitem.headline: Tortured body of Moroccan unionist found in sea.

text.p: The bound and tortured body of a Moroccan trade union activist has been found floating in the sea off the southern city of Agadir four days after he disappeared, a union spokesman said on Monday.
Abdellah Monacer, 38, secretary-general of Agadir fisherman's union, was found dead in the sea with severe injuries to his body, a spokesman for the umbrella Moroccan Labour Union (UMT) said.
"He was found on Saturday afternoon, tied up, with marks of criminal torture on his body," a UMT statement sent to Reuters said.
The spokesman said police had opened an inquiry to determine how Monacer, father of two children, had died.
